name: H3D — Honda 3D Multi-Object Detection and Tracking Dataset
description: Full-surround 3D multi-object detection and tracking dataset collected by Honda Research Institute USA in the San Francisco Bay Area. Utilizes a high-density 360-degree Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR to capture 160 crowded urban traffic driving scenarios (totaling 27,721 frames). Features 1.07 million annotated 3D bounding box tracklets across 8 agent categories, specifically addressing heavy occlusion, lane changing, and dense multi-agent interactions in urban traffic.
